tools.name: get_whale_trades
tools.description: Returns recent large Polymarket trades above a USD size threshold. Useful for detecting whale activity and smart-money flow.

params.name: market_slug
params.description: Optional: filter to a specific market slug

tools.name: get_market_odds
tools.description: Returns current prices, implied probability, volume, liquidity, and metadata for a specific Polymarket market by slug.

tools.name: get_trader_profile
tools.description: Returns performance data for any Polymarket wallet — PnL, ROI, win rate, trade count, classification, and leaderboard rank.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Returns top Polymarket traders ranked by PnL, ROI, win rate, or volume.

tools.name: get_market_summary
tools.description: Returns a pre-formatted, AI-citable summary paragraph for any Polymarket market, plus raw data fields.

tools.name: search_markets
tools.description: Full-text search across all active Polymarket markets. Supports natural language queries.

tools.name: get_market_movers
tools.description: Returns Polymarket markets with the largest price movements in the last 24 hours.

tools.name: get_site_stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate PolymarketScan platform statistics. Call this first to establish context before querying specific data.
